# 🏠 ZedProp — WhatsApp Property Management Engine
Automated Student & Landlord Portal • Built with n8n + Airtable + WhatsApp Business API

## 📱 Entry Point
Webhook • Message Parsing • Meta Verification

## 🎓 Student Portal
**9 Actions:** Menu • Documents • Lease PDF • Invoice PDF • Balance • Maintenance • Contact

📄 Auto-generated PDFs uploaded to Google Drive & sent via WhatsApp

📜 Lease PDF Generation
Airtable → HTML → PDFShift → Google Drive → WhatsApp

📄 Invoice PDF Generation
Airtable → HTML → PDFShift → Google Drive → WhatsApp

## 🔧 Maintenance + Notification
Student reports issue → Airtable record → Confirm student → **Alert landlord via WhatsApp**

## 🏠 Landlord Portal
**5 Actions:** Menu • Dashboard (occupancy, revenue) • Outstanding Balances • Contact

Real-time data from Airtable

## ❓ Unknown User
Not registered → Redirect to office
